lines.text: Yelp moved its databases to a new cluster by moving the disks, not the data.
Copying data to new machines would double the computers and take weeks for the biggest clusters.
lines.title: The usual way

lines.text: An EBS disk belongs to a zone, not to a cluster. So a new pod can pick up the same disk.
lines.title: The key idea

lines.text: One pod at a time, Yelp deleted the old pod, let the disk detach, and the new pod took over.
lines.title: One pod at a time

lines.text: About ninety clusters moved with no downtime and no data loss. The biggest took twelve hours.
lines.title: Results

lines.text: Rolling back is the same steps in reverse. Check backups and alerts before you start.
lines.title: Takeaway
